tei:div.tei:p: 81) rol chen gtor zlog gi 'don 'grigs bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs// 82)

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ thog mar sems bskyed sdom chog gi mchod rol gnyis la/ dkar/ rgya/ dung/ tshig bdun/ sku gsum/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= brgyud 'debs/ kun bzang yab yum= byin gyis rlobs/ rol mo byin rlabs nyin dang por bka' brgyad brgya rdung rgyas pa/ nyin gnyis par bka' brgyad 'bring po/ gsum par gsang 'dus brgya rdung*/ lnga par byin rlabs chung ba/ de rnams la dung chen/ mthar/ zil/ rkang bzhi/ rnga/ bzhag rol/ rang gi snying ga'i= bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi= hūm̐ḥ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs= lan gsum/ hūm̐ḥ chos kyi dbyings la= lan gsum/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon= dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs= dkar bgegs/ oṃ badz+ra= gang dag= mthar/ zhi rol/ dkar/ sarba bigh+naṃ= dung chen/ thing gsum/ sil/ 'jog med kyis/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni= bshigaḥ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid zhe sdang= gtong ngoḥ dung*/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen 'dus pa'i= stonaḥ dung*/ rgya/ brgyud gsum rol mo/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas= lhug shab+da= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags gsum re/ hūm̐ḥ rang byung= lhug mkha' la sharaḥ dung*/ rgya/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ thugs las= bskyedaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ lhug hūm̐ chen= chen po gsalaḥ hūm̐ḥ rang las= lhug spyan 'dren mgor/ rkang bzhi/ rgya/ dung/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med 83) hūm̐ḥ 'og min= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ ma dag= ya dhiḥ hūm̐ḥ sgeg dpa'= lhug shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ thing gcig sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐= 'dod chags= hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dbyings rig= lhug bdud rtsi= rnga 'don/ ga na pū dza hoḥ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ sil/ rkang*/ ḍā/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ mi sdug= lha la bstodaḥ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ bdag nyid= lhug sangs rgyas gyuraḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ brgya/ hūm̐= ye shes lha tshogs= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ye shes rgyal po= 'baraḥ rtsa sngags/ sum brgya/ stong tshig zhi rol kha 'bud bcas gong ltar/ rang rang= 'godaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ brgya rtsa/ stong tshig phaṭaḥdzaḥ lha tshogs= thon gyuraḥ tsaṇ+ḍa= brgya/ stong tshig gtor zlog las/ gtso bo'i thugs srog gi= mi tshugs par gyuraḥ gu ru shrī la srung sngags btags pa brgya/ skad cig gnam lcags= lta bur gyuraḥ las sngags brgya/ drag sngags lnga brgya/ las byang gi mchod pa/ hūm̐ḥ nyer spyod lnga dang= zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ bstod pa/ hūm̐ḥ mi sdug= lha la bstodaḥ yig brgya lan gcig seng gdong mdun skyed seng zlog las/ dung*/ rgya/ thing gcig sum gnyis 'jog yod/ swa bhā ba= mdun rten= niḥ seng gdong las byang gi hūm̐ḥ rnam thar= chen po gsalaḥ mdun bskyed kyi/ hūm̐ḥ tog la= bstimaḥ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ mgon po= dung*/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ dran pa= yul drug 'dod yon= rgya/ dung*/ rkang gsum/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ gti mug= stong nyid phyag rgya= rgya 84) dung*/ rkang bzhi/ 'jam rol sum gnyis/ hūm̐ḥ mi gnas= kun la bstodaḥ dung*/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ las byang gi thugs kar nyi gdan= bskoraḥ bsnyen sngags brgya/ sgrub sngags/ 'phro bar gyuraḥ a ka= sum brgya/ 'od zer phar= hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ ngo*/ brgya/ gtor zlog gi bdud 'dul drag mo'i= phalaḥ aḥka'i sham du/ nṛ tri= sbyar ba brgya/ srung zlog gi bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i= gyuraḥ a ka'i sngags gsham du srung sngags btags pa brgya/ hūm̐ḥ srung 'khor= phaṭaḥ a ka'i gsham du zlog sngags btags pa brgya/ sangs rgyas kyi ni= 'grub gyur cigaḥ la thal rdeb gsum/ mchod bstod rgyas par spro na/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum/ mchod phreng*/ kha 'bud spyi ltar/ gtor zlog gi hūm̐ḥ gti mug sha chen= lhu gcig mchod pa bsdu dus/ gtor zlog gi hūm̐:

yul la dbang pos= lhu gcig mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang*/ bstod pa/ hūm̐: mi gnas= kun la bstodaḥ yig brgya/ gsol ka ma mgon lcam dral nas/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams= mthar/ rgya/ dung*/ sil/ bzhag rol/ rgyas par mos na na raka skong bshags/ mar me'i smon lam bcas/ bsdu na/ yid la 'dod pa= bzhag rol mthar/ tshogs zhus tshogs grol na/ rkang bzhi/ rgya/ dung*/ thing gsum/ sil gnyis/ 'jog med/ tshogs ma grol na/ rgya/ dung*/ thing gcig sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ dpal chen gzhung gi hūm̐ḥ dpal chen thugs las= dam rdzas gyuraḥ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐ḥ gang zhig= dag tshangs= 'jam rol/ bzhag rol la kha 'bud med/ na mo/ rig 'dzin= khyad par du drag po dpal chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi= 85)da dgra nas rkang*/ dung*/ 'gugs rol/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ e las= gtubasaḥ rkang bzhi/ dung chen/ 'jam rol mthar/ dgu rdung glog ma ni/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ 'og gi mi gnas ye shes= 'di drag rdung chung ba yin/ pasaḥ rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dung*/ (Musical notes and signs here) sil/ rkang*/ sum gnyis/ gser skyems/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ gzu dpang*/ hūm̐ḥ khyab bdag= mthar/ 'jam rol/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ seng gdong brub bskyed/ hūm̐ḥ rten dang= brtsonaḥ 'gugs pa/ na mo rig 'dzin= tshar gsum/ gsum pa'i/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ bskal pa brgyad khri= drag brdung chung bas/ lhu gcig sngags ma thug bar/ 'dur/ dgu glog sngags 'ur nang*/ rkang bzhi man dgu thing gis 'dur yang chog 'gugs skul ma rdzogs bar drag rdung mos na/ sngags la thug dus dgu glog re/ sngags rol zhabs btang yang chog dmar nag= man dgu thing*/ 'dur/ dgos sngags re la thug dus dgu thing re rgyag sngags re 'don/ phur skor zhes par/ drag sngags so lnga/ ru lu/ bran dang*/ mthar/ 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ dgos/ zhal stabs mthar/

skong bshags thol glu/ tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= thing gcig sum gnyis las byang*/ lhag ma/ kyeḥ dang po= phyiraḥ lhag zhus/ byin rlabs/ thing gcig sil/ ḍā/ bzlog rol che bas/ hūm̐ḥ rnam bdag rang bzhin= ral 'don/ bzlog rol che ba/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ dgu glog drag brdung chung bas bzlog skul spyir/ mi gnas ye shes= tshar gcig dgu bzlog 86) 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ bzlog rol che bas/ bzlog gzhung*/ hūm̐ḥ rnam thar gsum ldan= dal 'don tshig rkang bzhi/ de nas 'dur/ 'di man rgyas par mtshams rol dgu thing yi ge rnams la rtags rgyab pa ltar/ de tsam mi nus na/ hūm̐ḥ phrol= hūm̐ḥ rnam shes= hūm̐ḥ lho phyogs thod mkhar= hūm̐ḥ nub phyogs zla gam= hūm̐ḥ byang phyogs ljang nag= hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi phur srung= hūm̐ḥ shar lho srid pa= hūm̐ḥ lho nub rig 'dzin= hūm̐ḥ nub byang dregs pa= hūm̐ḥ byang shar drag sngags= bcas la nges par dgos/ mthar dgu thing sil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ zlog sngags nyer gcig thing gcig rkang bzhi/ sil/ dgu thing gis/ seng gdong zlog pa/ mtshams rol rgyas pa'am/ hūm̐/ dran pa nye bar= mgor/ dgu thing gcig rgyab nas mtha' phud kyang chog mthar/ dgu thing*/ sil/ rkang gcig dgu thing gis/ gzer ka hūm̐ḥ dpal chen thugs las= mtshams rol rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ hūm̐ḥ bcom ldan dpal chen= hūm̐ḥ bdud kyi yum la= mthar/ dgu thing*/ sil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ sngags nyer gcig thing gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ dgu thing gis/ hūm̐/ gshin rje= mthar/ dgu thing*/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ dgu thing gis ltas ngan brgya bzlog bzlog rol che ba/ sil/ rkang gsum/ bzhag rol/ dpal seng gnyis kyi bzlog sngags nyer gcig re/ sangs rgyas kyis ni= thal rdeb/ thun gtor la/ 'gugs pa/ byin rlabs/ sngags bsngo/ rnga rdung spyi ltar/ drag brdung chung bas/ hūm̐ḥ zlog byed dpal chen= dgra bgegs dpung bcom bcas pas 'phang*/ gsol ka bkyag bskul/ chad brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod/

bshags/ rten/ bsdu/ ldang*/ yig brgya/ bsngo smon gsum/ bkra shis bcas/ ༈ grol nyin 87) bsgral las 'go mthar/ drag rdung che 'bring gnyis gang mos/ zhal stabs chung ba/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom gyis ling ga sregs/ gzhan 'dra/ za lam tha ma skyur/ ltas ngan brgya zlog mthar/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ gtor ma'i ye shes= dpal seng bzlog sngags/ thal rdeb/ 'gugs pa lan gcig byin rlabs/ dpal seng sngags bsngo/ rnga rdung spyi ltar gyis/ hūm̐ḥ bcom ldan khro bo'i= zab mdo bdud zlog bcas/ 'di man rnga rdung spyi ltar la/ sgo dbye/ las byang bskul/ chad tho/ sum gcig sil/ dgra bgegs dpung 'joms kyis sgo khar gtor btsugs steng*/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ dgu glog drag rdung chung bas/ bskul pa/ sil/ rkang bzhi/ gser skyems drag chung*/ zor skyems/ hūm̐/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad= drag chung yin/ za lam/ gshin rje kun gyi lcam mo= drag chung mthar/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom tshar gsum/ sil/ sum rdung kho nas 'phang sar 'gro ba bka' brgyad kyi dmigs bsal yin/ 'phang sar/ 'ur/ rkang*/ drag chung*/ skul pa/ gser skyems sngar ltar/ mthar 'ur nang*/ srid pa ho'i rgyab yig bklags la mchod/ bzhag rol/ 'gugs pa lan gcig 'gugs rol/ dgu thing*/ zor cha 'di rgyas par byed na/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen rol pa'i= bcad pa'i phyiraḥ klad pa'i dkyil du rdo zor yaḥ rab chad= man sbrel/ de'i 'gros zor cha bcu gcig/ 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ zlog rol che bas/ ltas ngan brgya zlog mthar/ 'ur/ rkang bzhi/ bzhag rol/ 'gugs pa lan gcig drag rol che bas/ thun gtor/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen= mtha' phud/ 'ur/ dgra bgegs dpung bcom gsum/ rkang bzhi/ bcad ma/ drag chung gis/ srung 'khor*/ 88) hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yiḥ spyan mig nyi zla 'bar zhing sregaḥ thugs las khro bo'i tshwa tshwa 'phroḥ stong gsum sprul pa'i me yis 'gengasaḥ phyogs mtshams mtshon cha 'chol bas gtams: bdag med stong par mtshams bcad doḥ

dgu glog sil zhabs sngags/ oṃ sūr+ya tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro ta dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bzhag rol/ lam phyed tsam sleb pa na kha phyir gyur nas zlog sngags/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa= breng shag rbadaḥ thing gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ 'di'ang bka' brgyad la dgos/ gzhan la mi dgos/ sgo drung brtan ma/ 'bru gsum/ thang gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ brtan ma mthar/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ 'gugs pa tshar lan gcig 'gugs rol/ sum gnyis/ rta bro/ sum gnyis/ bkra shis/ sum gcig thing gsum/ sil/ bzhag rol/ nang du tshe snyen bzla zhing*/ thing gcig rgya/ dung*/ sil/ sum gnyis/ rig 'dus tshe 'gugs/ badz+ra rak+ṣaḥ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ tshogs grol/ yar tshogs nas gral du bzhugs/ thing gcig rgya/ dung*/ sil/ sum gnyis/ dngos grub ni/ hūm̐ḥ byin rlabs= mthar/ sum rdung rtse med kyis dngos grub 'gyed tshar nas/ sil/ bzhag rol/ gsol ka bkyag rgyu man snga nyin ltar/ zlog pa 'di bsdu dus/ hūm̐ḥ rnam thar= tshig bzhi/ hūm̐ḥ dpal chen thugs las= lhu gcig shar phyogs/ lho phyogs/ nub phyogs/ byang phyogs/ shar lho lho nub/ nub byang*/ byang shar/ lhu re re 'don pas 'thus/ bka' brgyad rkyang pa byed dus 'di'i nang seng gdong rigs dor/ bka' brgyad zlog stong 'dra dgos dus/ rdo (89) grub kyis mdzad pa'i zlog bsdus yod kyang*/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig byin rlabs che bas/ seng gdong zlog pa'i/ hūm̐ḥ zhal dang= zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig dor la/ hūm̐ḥ bed gshegs yongs rdzogs gar dgu'i rol pa canaḥ man tshig rkang bcu drug de bsags na legs/ seng gdong dang sbrags yod tshe/ zhal tshig gcig skyur mi dgos/ gtor zlog zhig la yum ka'i seng gdong 'di 'dra'i zab gnad can rgya bod gnyis na med/ gdugs dkar gtor chen sgrol ma'i g.yul zlog drang srong bka' mthu/ bka' brgyad zlog pa/ seng gdong zlog pa/ lo k+t+ri'i zlog pa/ chos skyong spyi zlog thams cad 'di nang ma tshang ba med/

dpal chen 'dus pa 'di/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang gsang rdzogs gnyis las kyang zab/ dpyod shes na rnying ma'i gter chos gzhan rnams 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bu la/ snying tig 'di mar gyi snying khu phyung ba tsam gyi khyad nges par 'dug gzhan bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs kyi dmar khrid ni snying tig kho na la ma gtogs/ rnying ma'i chos gzhan tsho dbang lung tshig brgyud tsam las deng song gtan nas med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub dgos phyin chad snying thig 'di nyid nyams su ma blangs ka med red 'dug lags/ pad+ma ma ṇis so// dge'o// 90)
